newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASKO EXTENDS GAINS TO NEW HIGHS ON RESULT.
newsitem.headline: ASKO EXTENDS GAINS TO NEW HIGHS ON RESULT.

text.p: Shares in Finnish plastic pipes and furniture group Asko rose sharply to their highest level in memory after the company reported a 42 percent rise in Jan-Aug profits and said 1996 would be up on 1995, brokers said.
At 1340/1040 GMT, Asko traded at 288.30 markka, up 18.00 markka, or about seven percent, after hitting a 289.00 markka high. Volume was a modest seven million markka.
"The share has risen (up 72 percent this year) as results have been seen improving and now as they materialise, it rose again," one broker said.
